name: apple-home
description: Read and control Apple Home through public HomeKit APIs or curated Shortcuts

interface.shortDescription: Ask your home. Make it happen.
interface.longDescription: Apple Home lets Codex and ChatGPT inspect the Home graph, read public HomeKit characteristics, write metadata-validated values, and run scenes through a local iPhone, iPad, or Mac Catalyst companion. Curated Apple Shortcuts remain available as a fallback. Physical controls require explicit confirmation, and high-risk services require in-app approval or fail closed.
defaultPrompt: List the homes and accessories you can access.
Set the desk lamp to 40 percent brightness.
